title: Car Rental Rate Classes: Accepted Rental Lengths and Driver Ages
content:
Every one of the six Car Rental Rate Classes states the shortest and longest rental it may be booked for, the youngest and oldest main driver it accepts, the age below which the young driver fee applies, and the per-day young and senior driver amounts.

| Rate class | Min days | Max days | Youngest driver | Oldest driver | Young driver age limit | Young driver fee per day (USD) | Senior driver fee per day (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Pay Now Saver Rate | 2 | 21 | 21 | 75 | 25 | 32.00 | 18.00 |
| Pay Now Standard Rate | 1 | 28 | 21 | 75 | 25 | 29.00 | 15.00 |
| Pay At Counter Flex Rate | 1 | 30 | 21 | 79 | 25 | 25.00 | 12.00 |
| Inclusive Flex Rate | 1 | 30 | 21 | 79 | 25 | 22.00 | 0.00 |
| Premium Inclusive Rate | 1 | 30 | 25 | 79 | 25 | 19.00 | 0.00 |
| Corporate Negotiated Drive Rate | 1 | 60 | 21 | 79 | 25 | 0.00 | 0.00 |

The minimum and maximum days are whole numbers of days the class may be booked for. The youngest and oldest driver figures are the ages in whole years the class accepts for the main driver. The young driver age limit is the age in whole years below which the young driver fee applies, and the two fee columns are charges per rental day, in US dollars, for a main driver below that limit and for a main driver aged seventy or over.

**Reading the columns together.** The young driver age limit stands at 25 on all six classes, but the amount behind it falls as the class rises: 32 on the Pay Now Saver Rate, 29 on the Pay Now Standard Rate, 25 on the Pay At Counter Flex Rate, 22 on the Inclusive Flex Rate, 19 on the Premium Inclusive Rate and 0 on the Corporate Negotiated Drive Rate. The senior driver amount likewise runs 18, 15 and 12 on the first three classes and 0 on the remaining three. Only the Premium Inclusive Rate raises its youngest accepted driver to 25, which is also its young driver age limit; on that class the young driver fee of 19 therefore never falls due on an accepted main driver. The longest bookable rental runs from 21 days on the Pay Now Saver Rate to 60 days on the Corporate Negotiated Drive Rate.
